name: manual_fe2edf
claim: Bind latency budgets to explicit populations: scheduled arrivals and successful calls are distinct; retain both measurements and record dated operator threshold amendments without rewriting historical results.

decisions.notes: Claude independent C6 diagnostic measured scheduled p95 57.7ms and successful-call p95 53.3ms. Both missed the historical 50ms limit. Operator directly amended both to 60ms on 2026-11-07; neither agent diagnostic substitutes for three operator passes.
